title: Emmy Noether: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Working Drafts
description:
Dedicated Emmy Noether record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. The public reader surface remains the curated numbered-paper corpus: cumulative readers, standalone English paper PDFs, compact language/source packages, and scoped source-audit correction packets.

Pending local upload queue. After the latest public version, local staging adds RA37/RA40/RA41 for Paper 04, RA42 Paper 05, RA43-RA48 Paper 06 pp.161-196, Paper 03/Paper 11/Paper 12/Paper 13 GDZ source/provenance witness support, Paper 10/Paper 11/Paper 12 compact GDZ source-audit webdrops, Paper 06 GDZ remaining-source witness pp.173-196, targeted Paper 06/Paper 07/Paper 08 audit drops, targeted German cumulative candidates P03 RA57, the compact RA58 German roll-up baseline, P21 RA59, P23 RA60, P22 RA61/RA62/RA63, P04 RA64, P02 RA65 no-patch audit, P08 RA66 no-patch micro-audit, P06 RA67 source-marker repair, P08 RA68 source-marker placement repair, P24 RA69 footnote-counter repair, P25 RA70 source-header/footnote-placement repair, P29 RA71 source-header/footnote-counter repair, P30 RA72 source-header/footnote-counter repair, P31 RA73 source-header/footnote-counter repair, P32 IA source witness pp.221-228, P32 RA74 source-author-block/page-break repair, P33 IA source witness pp.071-073, P33 RA75 Bologna source-text repair, P34 GDZ source witness pp.641-692, RA76 structural duplicate fix for Papers 40-43, P09/P10/P11 RA56, P14 RA55, P15 RA54, P16 RA53, P17 RA52, P18 RA51, P19 RA50, and P20 RA49, Paper 20 Lean/source-audit formula-fix material, German source-audit support companions, and a Slavic multilingual handoff through Papers 01-21 in Ukrainian, Russian, Interslavic Latin, and deterministic Interslavic Cyrillic. These pending files are not public Zenodo files until a token-backed upload/publish pass succeeds.

RA58-RA76 / P34 source-witness caveat. The RA58 package is a compact German cumulative roll-up of already targeted source-confirmed repair branches, producing a 430-page German TeX/PDF candidate. RA59 builds on RA58 and applies three Paper 21 source-confirmed repairs; RA60 builds on RA59 and applies one Paper 23 source-confirmed repair; RA61 records a Paper 22 pp.53-60 checked-no-patch audit; RA62 applies 14 Paper 22 repairs across printed pp.61-69; RA63 applies two Paper 22 repairs across printed pp.70-79; RA64 restores one Paper 04 source-visible Section 9 heading footnote on printed p.152; RA65 records the source-confirmed no-patch `L_j`/`L_j^2` finding in Paper 02; RA66 records the source-confirmed Paper 08 Omega-note bracket/factor no-patch finding; RA67 restores six source-symbol wrappers in Paper 06; RA68 moves one Paper 08 source marker onto the displayed formula; RA69 resets the ordinary footnote counter before Paper 24; RA70 restores the Paper 25 source subtitle/author header and moves its existing footnote text to the source subtitle marker; RA71 restores the Paper 29 source author line and resets Paper 29 ordinary footnotes. RA72 restores the Paper 30 source author block and resets Paper 30 ordinary footnotes. RA73 restores the Paper 31 source author line and resets Paper 31 ordinary footnotes. RA74 builds on RA73 by inserting a clear page before Paper 32 and restoring the Brauer/Noether source author block without body prose/math changes. RA75 builds on RA74 by replacing the active Paper 33 block with the Bologna congress source text, restoring the Bologna author/title block, resetting Paper 33 footnotes, inserting the article boundary, and preserving/adjusting the two source matrix displays; its own ledger still requests a further visual pass before Paper 33 certification and explicitly does not audit Paper 34. RA76 removes a duplicated first run of Papers 40-43 from the German cumulative candidate and keeps the later RA10-appended P40-P43 body with apparatus after Paper 43, while converting problematic Unicode quote/guillemet/em-dash glyphs to TeX-safe forms for clean rendering. The P34 GDZ source-witness package adds GDZ/EuDML page images and page maps for printed pp.641-692, but it is below the 650 dpi crop-certification rule and is source/provenance support only, not corrected TeX or dense-math certification. These packages reduce pending-queue fragmentation and are useful branch-reconciliation targets, but they are not fresh page-by-page certification, not critical editions, and not multilingual propagation.

RA78 Paper 14-16 footnote-reset caveat. RA78 is queued as a targeted German page-boundary/footnote-counter repair after RA77. It adds clear page boundaries and ordinary footnote-counter resets before Papers 14, 15, and 16, with source PDFs for those three papers and the RA77-to-RA78 diff included in the package. It is targeted repair evidence only: not full Paper 14, Paper 15, or Paper 16 certification, not whole-corpus source closure, not a critical edition, and not propagated to non-German branches.

RA77 Paper 17 repair caveat. RA77 is queued as a targeted German Paper 17 footnote-continuity repair after RA76. It restores the full Paper 17 source title, replaces an artificial duplicate split header before Section 5 with a continuation note, sets the Section 5 continuation footnote counter so the first continuation note renders as 13, and makes formula (39) source footnote markers 21 and 22 explicit before resetting the following ordinary counter. It is targeted footnote-counter/rendering repair evidence only: not full Paper 17 certification, not whole-corpus source closure, not a critical edition, and not propagated to non-German branches.

Slavic handoff caveat. The Slavic package is a translation/checkpoint handoff rather than an independent source-audit closure. The visible Papers 01-21 reader TeX passed a local placeholder/mojibake grep, but some sidecar terminology/glossary JSON/log material contains question-mark mojibake; Paper 22 is WIP only and its Ukrainian/Russian working terminology seed also contains question-mark mojibake; the bundle carries provenance/tool material and raw audit/log warning history; and newer German source-audit fixes still need synchronization into those language branches.

Status at a glance. This is not a certified critical edition. The files are useful working drafts, translation drafts, source/provenance witnesses, and source-audit correction packets; subtle formula errors, scan-reading errors, apparatus drift, and cross-language synchronization errors may remain. Verify important equations, tables, theorem statements, and unusual notation against the source witnesses before citation-critical use.

Known open items. Paper 02 body pp.23-90 is closed at the RA29/RA30 page-level standard, Tabelle I p.91 is source-checked at RA31, Tabelle II p.92 rows 0-23 are checked at plate-row level through RA33/RA34, and RA65 records that the suspected body `L_j^2` display near Section 14 is source-confirmed and should not be patched by analogy with the separate Table I correction. RA41 reports Paper 04 pp.118-154 source-symbol closure at the current standard. RA48 reports Paper 06 pp.161-196 checked in a German source-critical candidate branch. Paper 03/Paper 11/Paper 12 standalone source-witness packages are provenance/witness support only; Paper 10/Paper 11/Paper 12 compact GDZ audit webdrops provide actionable patch targets and no-fix traps without applied cumulative TeX; Paper 13 has actionable audit findings plus the targeted P12/P13 RA48 candidate, but no full Paper 13 certification. The P03/P04/P09/P10/P11/P14/P15/P16/P17/P18/P19/P20/P21/P22/P23/P24/P25/P29/P30/P31/P32/P40-P43 candidates and the RA58/RA76 consolidation layers are targeted German repairs/consolidation only and require branch reconciliation and non-German propagation before promotion. P03 RA57 restores title spelling `Variabeln`, the source-visible Paper 03 author line, and formula (2) `\rho=\sum_i\rho_i\le n`, while recording the older Paper 05 RA42 title-footnote row as stale/closed in the current base; RA58 carries those repairs forward into the compact German roll-up; P21 RA59 applies source-confirmed Riemann cross-reference, Heun citation, and formula (143) prose-argument repairs; P22 RA62/RA63 cover targeted source-confirmed repairs across printed pp.61-79; P04 RA64 restores the source-visible Section 9 heading footnote on printed p.152; P08 RA66 records the Paper 08 Omega-note bracket/factor no-patch trap; P09/P10/P11 RA56 restores source-visible author lines and applies targeted Zermelo citation, index/display, and Omega-Gamma notation repairs; P14 RA55 applies source-confirmed repairs on printed pp.190, 198, and 200; P15 RA54 applies the printed p.152 Latin-x index repair and p.154 Schur S. 355 citation repair; P29 RA71 restores the source-visible author line and footnote restart without body prose/math changes. P30 RA72 restores the source-visible author block and footnote restart without body prose/math changes. P31 RA73 restores the source-visible author line and footnote restart without body prose/math changes. P32 RA74 restores the source-visible Brauer/Noether author block and article page break without body prose/math changes. The P32 IA source-witness package is provenance support only, not a corrected TeX branch. The P33 IA source-witness package is provenance support only, not a corrected TeX branch, not a translation, and not Paper 33 certification. RA75 is a targeted Paper 33 source-text repair candidate, not full Paper 33 certification and not Paper 34 audit evidence. RA76 removes duplicate P40-P43 structure but does not certify the retained P40-P43 body against sources. The P34 GDZ source-witness package is provenance support only and Paper 34 still needs dense math/source micro-audit. Noether branch reconciliation after RA65/RA66/RA67/RA68/RA69/RA70/RA71/RA72/RA73/RA74/RA75/RA76, non-German propagation to EN/ES/JA/FR/ZH/UK/RU/ISV and the newer Slavic branches, and full symbol-level source audit beyond the checked tranches remain queued.

Corrections and collaboration. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through GitHub issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
